heading: Which world will you choose?
note: A little wonder on every page.
instruction: Choose a book. Shape the adventure.
welcomeInstruction: Turn the page to step into the world.

books.summary: Build your own gadgets and take on the robots causing trouble in your neighborhood.
books.welcome: An adventure of homemade gadgets, troublesome robots, and inventions that don’t always work quite as planned.

books.summary: Discover your magic, make unlikely friends, and help a world that’s losing its own.
books.welcome: An adventure of unexpected magic, new friends, and a world that needs your help. Your choices will guide the way.

books.summary: Join a spaceship’s crew, explore strange worlds, and uncover what’s happening to the missing planets.
books.welcome: An adventure of strange planets, daring rescues, and a spaceship crew far from home. There’s a whole universe to explore.
